name: Peak Near Shackleton (CSA Rover Scenario)
agency: Illustrative scenario for Canada's lunar rover plans (CSA, Space Apps partner). CSA has not published a landing site
description: Representative south polar region aligned with Canada's lunar rover program objectives to demonstrate survival across harsh lunar lighting transitions.
coord_source: coordinates supplied by the project team (2026-11-15)
warnings: Local slope 11.0 deg exceeds typical lander tolerance (10 deg)
Team-supplied coordinates used as given (no closed local summit within 0.5 km); site sits on a steep slope - coordinates pending verification

snap.note: fine snap to local high point; keep team-supplied coords if no closed summit within 0.5 km

horizon_source: LOLA LDEM_80S_80M raycast 100 km, curvature-corrected, mast 2.0 m

fields.sun.vis/earth.vis: 1 if apparent elevation > horizon mask at that azimuth (airless, no refraction)
fields.sun.pwr: sin(solar elevation) when sun visible else 0 (horizontal panel efficiency)
fields.sun.pwr_v: cos(solar elevation) when sun visible else 0 (vertical sun-tracking panel)
fields.sun.t_set: hours until next terrain sunset (power loss); null if dark or no sunset before dataset end
fields.sun.t_rise: hours until next sunrise; null if lit or no sunrise before dataset end
fields.earth.t_set: hours until next Earthset (DTE loss); null if Earth hidden or no Earthset before dataset end
